entries.title: Build-stamped Cloud endpoint manifest committed to the repository
entries.description: Commit 8c14569 committed cloud-endpoints.json with channel='staging', violating the manifest's own documented contract (packaging stamps the channel at build time; the committed default is development). This broke apps/desktop/test/cloud-endpoint.test.ts 'parses the committed repository manifest' (suite went 2453 passed / 1 failed at HEAD 63fa479, contradicting the certified 0-failed claim) and pointed non-packaged developer checkouts at the staging Cloud origin instead of the local development server.
entries.generalCause: A release-preparation step mutated a tracked source file instead of a build-local copy, and the change was not re-verified against the full suite before certification evidence was recorded.
entries.fix: Restored the committed manifest to channel='development' while keeping the staging endpoint entry recorded for the known staging deployment (commit c217e96).
entries.regressionCoverage: apps/desktop/test/cloud-endpoint.test.ts (existing test detected the regression; restored to green).

entries.title: Deterministic verification gate cannot pass real monorepo suites (300s per-command ceiling, no override)
entries.description: runVerification enforces a 300s per-command timeout and no caller could override it. This repository's own full 'npm test' runs ~15-20 minutes, so any autonomous run whose verification command is a real monorepo suite has that command killed into a fabricated failure and the run terminates blocked with VERIFICATION_FAILED.
entries.generalCause: A defensive default timeout was made non-configurable; the verification-service comment acknowledged long real suites but no opt-in path existed.
entries.fix: Added caller-opt-in verificationTimeoutMs to OrchestratorRunOptions, forwarded to runVerification (commit bf6bc14). Default unchanged (300s) for every existing path; the corpus runner passes 45 minutes for monorepo-suite oracles.
entries.regressionCoverage: The corpus itself is the regression proof: every CodeForge npm-test task exercises the raised ceiling (its oracle requires >15 minutes of verification). The default ceiling remains covered by existing verification-service timeout tests.
